newsitem.title: USA: Italy convergence plan to go to EU on June 25.
newsitem.headline: Italy convergence plan to go to EU on June 25.

text.p: Italy's convergence plan for economic and monetary union (EMU) will be put before the European Union's monetary committee next Wednesday, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Friday.
He told reporters in Denver, Colorado for the annual summit of the G7 industrialized nations, that the plan was already with a department of the European Commission which was studying it.
"It will be presented to the monetary committee on June 25, as scheduled," Ciampi added.
EU countries have to submit a convergence plan to outline how they intend to sustain the economic parameters required for Europe's planned single currency.
Italian government sources said the Italian plan, once approved by the monetary committee, could be put forward to a meeting of EU finance ministers scheduled for July 7.
Italy has said it will make every effort to meet and sustain the criteria for EMU, including the budget deficit-to-gross domestic product ratio ceiling of three percent.
